text: Why Doug pay forty-five thousand dollars a year for college in America...
but Germany pay almost zero?
Same degree.
Same Doug.
This is Doug. Doug want degree.
Doug need paper for job. So Doug go to college.
College is building. Larry own building.
Larry say price. Price high. Doug pay.
Four years. Every year. One hundred eighty thousand dollars. Doug pay.
Not every Doug pay full price. Larry give discount. Discount called scholarship. Still big price.
Doug have no fish. Doug go to Fox.
Fox give loan. Doug sign paper.
Now Doug owe fish. If Doug pay late, Fox take more fish. Fish on top of fish.
This is called interest.
Many Doug owe. Many, many Doug.
This is called student debt.
Doug poor.
Now Germany. Boss Bear run country.
Boss Bear take small fish from everybody.
This is called tax.
Boss Bear use fish to pay for college. And roads. And hospital.
Student go to class. Student keep fish.
Student still pay for food and igloo. But not for class.
Student pay almost zero.
This is called public university.
Doug angry.
In real life, private college cost about forty-five thousand dollars a year.
Public college in your state? About twelve thousand. Still not free.
And Americans owe more than one point six trillion dollars in student loans.
German public universities charge no tuition. Only a small fee each semester.
But nothing is free. Germans pay with higher tax.
Doug move to Germany. Doug study. Doug happy.
Doug eat fish. Doug sleep. Doug graduate. No tuition debt.
Doug see tax paper. Doug sigh.
Doug think. Doug think hard. Doug still choose Germany.
Would you pay tax for free college... or pay Larry? Tell Doug in the comments.
